title: Cleaning Up a Biohazardous Spill Outside of a Biosafety Cabinet
author: Steven W Wilhelm
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wgjfbun
materials: Assemble all spill cleanup materials and review procedure.
Wipe up disinfectant, repeat if necessary.
Segregate contaminated cleanup materials into the appropriate biohazardous waste containers.

steps.title: Isolate area and settle aerosols
steps.instruction: Close off the area and allow aerosols to settle.

steps.title: Don appropriate personal protective equipment
steps.instruction: Put on a laboratory coat, safety glasses or chemical splash goggles as appropriate, and nitrile gloves.

steps.title: Apply disinfectant to spill area
steps.instruction: Pour (do not spray) disinfectant onto the contaminated surface that is covered with paper towels, pouring around the periphery of the spill and moving inward; allow the disinfectant the appropriate contact time.

steps.title: Remove and dispose of contaminated material
steps.instruction: Wipe up the spill and place the waste in biohazardous waste containers.

steps.title: Re‑apply disinfectant for final decontamination
steps.instruction: Re‑apply disinfectant to the contaminated surface and let it stand for the proper contact time.
